bandwidth_model: model_bytes = processed*(4 queue-read + 3 img-recolor + 4 depth-write [+ 2 owner-write if instrumented]) + processed*4 neighbors*3 img-read + cas_attempts*8 (visited CAS RMW) + (filled-1)*4 (enqueue writes). Derived lower-bound model of algorithmic traffic, ~61 B/pixel on solid interiors; L2 caching deflates real DRAM bytes, 32B sectors inflate them. Compare only against the measured copy peak; ncu is ground truth.

scenes.note: 64M px stretch: guarded — host RAM, not the GPU, is the ceiling
